2609.23360.title: Human-guided physics-constrained AI agents construct an auditable model of soil-plug evolution
2609.23360.paper_summary: Engineering predictions require physical mechanisms to be translated consistently into equations, discretization, code, and validation, yet errors can propagate despite local checks. Artificial-intelligence (AI) agents automate scientific tasks, but coordinating and independently auditing the theory-to-solver process under physical constraints and human oversight remains unresolved. We introduce a human-in-the-loop, physics-constrained multi-agent workflow where human experts define admissible physics and modeling boundaries, while agents retrieve evidence, derive equations, implement solvers, and audit the theory-to-code chain. Applied to soil-plug evolution during suction-caisson installation, the workflow generated and audited 6 formulations in 2.9 h of agent execution once physical knowledge and inputs were prepared. Among these formulations, adding seepage-driven soil void-ratio evolution to the geometric baseline reduced mean absolute final-heave error from 58.4% to 9.0% across 14 profiles; the selected model further incorporated near-wall dilation and achieved mean absolute percentage errors of 12.4% across 9 final-state cases and 4.2% at the endpoints of 5 process histories. Beyond predictive performance, blinded replay recovered all 9 target problems, while an independent audit uncovered 5 implementation problems after 36 predefined checks had passed. Overall, this work extends multi-agent AI beyond task automation toward human-governed engineering solvers.
2609.23360.paper_summary_zh: 工程預測需要將物理機制一致地轉換為方程式、離散化、程式碼和驗證，然而儘管有局部檢查，錯誤仍然可能傳播。人工智慧（AI）代理自動化科學任務，但在物理限制和人類監督下協調和獨立審核理論到求解器的過程仍然未解決。我們引入了一種人類參與的、受物理約束的多代理工作流程，其中人類專家定義可接受的物理和建模邊界，而代理則檢索證據、推導方程式、實施求解器並審核理論到程式碼的鏈條。應用於吸力基樁安裝過程中的土壤堵塞演變，該工作流程在準備好物理知識和輸入後，生成並審核了6個公式，執行時間為2.9小時。在這些公式中，將滲流驅動的土壤孔隙比演變添加到幾何基線中，將14個剖面的平均絕對最終隆起誤差從58.4%降低到9.0%；所選模型進一步納入了近壁擴張，並在9個最終狀態案例中達到了12.4%的平均絕對百分比誤差，在5個過程歷史的端點達到了4.2%。除了預測性能外，盲測重播恢復了所有9個目標問題，而獨立審核在36個預定檢查通過後發現了5個實施問題。總的來說，這項工作將多代理AI的應用從任務自動化擴展到人類主導的工程求解器。
